observations: Photo 0 shows a metal car alternator/charging unit with a pulley and vented housing; no readable brand/model plate.
Photo 1 shows the opposite side of the same unit with mounting ears and a circular cover; no readable part number.
Photo 2 shows the rear side with a threaded shaft/connection area; no readable part number.

claims.claim: Also deals on all kinds of cars spare parts
claims.evidence: Seller’s text only; photos show one alternator-like part, not proof of dealing in all kinds.

risks.risk: Exact alternator model/voltage/amperage is unknown, so compatibility with the buyer’s car may be wrong.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the alternator label/part number (or stamping) and the connector type; also photo of the mounting bolt pattern.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic alternator with unknown compatibility (worst case: may not fit).

risks.risk: Working condition is unknown (could be dead, noisy, or have worn bearings/diodes).
risks.proof: Video of the alternator being tested (bench test) showing output voltage/current, or a receipt/test sheet; alternatively a short running test on the vehicle with charging voltage reading.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not proven working (worst case: not working).

risks.risk: Pulley/belt alignment and bearing health are unknown; pulley may be loose or damaged.
risks.proof: Close-up of the pulley face and a clip showing the pulley spins smoothly without wobble; measure pulley play.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as needing inspection/possible replacement (worst case: pulley/bearing issue).

risks.risk: Electrical connector and regulator type are unknown; may require different plug/regulator.
risks.proof: Clear photo of the electrical connector and any regulator/brush area (where accessible) plus part number.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as requiring possible wiring/connector adaptation (worst case: not plug-and-play).

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the alternator label/part number/stamping (front and rear).
Bench test result photo/video (output voltage/current) or vehicle charging test with a multimeter reading.
Video clip of pulley spinning smoothly (no wobble) and showing no grinding/noise.
Photo of the electrical connector/regulator area to confirm plug type.
response.reason: The photos identify the item only as an alternator-like car charging unit, but the exact model/part number and working condition are not verifiable remotely; without those, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set.
